items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow will play today (back); expected all week after full Friday practice.
items.why: Full practice Friday, self-reported ready, elevated backup only as precaution
items.implication: Start with confidence; CIN passing game intact
items.opportunity: Full snap share for Burrow and WRs

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; official status unlikely until 2:30pm ET; RapSheet tone was bullish.
items.why: Optimism + bullish insider tone + no elevation

items.text: Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) listed GTD with optimism he can play and would wear flak jacket; RapSheet bullish tone, practiced Friday, team did not elevate a WR.
items.why: Improved steadily, limited Friday practice, no WR elevation
items.implication: Projectable with injury docks; status likely ~2:30pm ET
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if active but reduced efficiency possible from rib/flak

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 1, no practice
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; volume shifts to remaining pass-catchers

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots due to foot injury.
items.implication: Sit; DK Metcalf primary, deeper WRs elevated
items.opportunity: Snap/target share increase for remaining PIT WRs

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) doubtful Sunday; could return next week. Elevated Myarick.
items.implication: Sit this week; Mayer elevated role

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) sounds fine with no real docks in projections.
Expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with RJ Harvey sounding doubtful/not expected.
items.implication: Coleman stash/stream candidate in deeper formats

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) sounds like true game-time decision.
items.why: Reports indicate genuine uncertainty into MNF
items.opportunity: If inactive: route share to remaining LAR pass-catchers

items.text: Expecting decent look at Germie Bernard with Michael Pittman (foot) out.
items.why: Pittman ruled out opens WR snaps/targets behind Metcalf

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 2 vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in Wednesday practice; DNP remainder of week
items.implication: Sit; volume to Schultz and remaining WRs

items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip) a pre-game decision for Monday night vs Giants; true GTD after missing practice.
items.why: Hip; DNP consecutive days, different from prior psoas
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; start if active
items.opportunity: If out: TE heavier usage + other WRs

items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey (hamstring) unlikely to play Sunday vs Jaguars.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining DEN RBs

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) expected to play Sunday at Baltimore.
items.why: Issue not significant; limited but progressing

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snap rate, 21/24 RB touches through 3Q, 40% target share (tied team lead); Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.implication: Strong RB start; upside to RB1

items.text: Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score (tied Bijan league-high), 19% target share last 10, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
Loves Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 utilization, 26% target share, 100% RB red-zone touches; CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Wk1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further as underdogs.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara return + negative script risk
items.implication: Fade/sit if better options; three-headed backfield risk
items.conflict: Usage already reduced; Kamara return further limits
